text: Equities are advancing with semiconductor leadership, but equal-weight participation is lagging. Credit spreads are widening while volatility stays subdued — stress is building beneath a calm options market. Treasury yields are little changed on the week, so rates are not a driver. Equity strength is not being confirmed by credit, which has historically tended to lead.
